content: For CEI task, we found that when the model ran on the sequence representation of discourse argument (DA AVG LSTM), its performance was higher than the plain sequence of word embeddings (Word LSTM). Finally, in both subtasks, when the models ran on both Word-level and DA-Level (Full LSTM), they obtained the highest performance.
